topics.title: What DNS does
topics.explanation: DNS translates domain names into IP addresses. Name resolution is separate from encrypting a connection.
keyPoints: DNS resolves names to IP addresses.
Name resolution does not itself encrypt traffic.

questions.prompt: What is the main job of DNS?
options: Translate domain names into IP addresses
questions.explanation: DNS provides name resolution. Encryption and storing web content are separate functions.
questions.hint: Think about how a device finds a named destination.
